findings: Product-owner approval lacked structured identity, timestamp, and approved-surface coverage.
The candidate branch mixed program-contract and ADLC-MIG-001 closeout files into ADLC-MIG-002 scope.
The verifier did not prove substantive ADR rationale, reversal paths, or approval evidence.
remediation: Landed the authoritative program contract and ADLC-MIG-001 closeout separately in PR #56 before rebuilding this branch.
Recorded the user's approval with identity, role, time, source statement, and exact approved surfaces.
Strengthened the verifier and added adversarial checks for missing reversal paths and approval timestamps.

doc_honesty_section: This evidence proves product-contract completeness and inventory coverage, not implementation or provider behavior.

limitations: Positioning remains a hypothesis until external beta use is measured.
Behavioral, installation, release, and support claims remain owned by downstream tasks.
